name: Prompt-Injection-OWASP-Benchmark
description:
OWASP LLM01 Prompt Injection/Jailbreak Benchmark v1
	

This dataset is designed for evaluating guardrails and detectors on prompt injection and jailbreak robustness while measuring false positives.
It is aligned to OWASP GenAI Top 10 LLM01 prompt injection scenarios, with multimodal attacks intentionally excluded for this v1 text-only benchmark.
